title: Fixed Twin Bridge Ice Skate Display
description: One newly authored complete static ice-skate exterior. A low forward instep and high rear ankle form one thick hollow boot with an oblique open throat and full inner floor, over a thin continuous outsole. Two whole separated raised bridges connect the shoe to a single continuous narrow blade with raised rounded ends and a finite central ground edge; the long under-arch stays genuinely open. Six coarse fixed crossed laces are actual solids. No old winter boot mesh is imported or extracted: the old snow pair has bulky folded cuffs, four independent ground tread/heel blocks per foot and no suspended blade-bearing structure, whereas this new whole assembly has a low hard shoe silhouette, continuous narrow runner and two elevated supports. Three opaque untextured PBR roles, metres, Z up and full horizontally centred ground origin. One complete skate prop, zero scenes or paired-colour variants. No foot, wearer, ice terrain, sharpened-edge detail, fastening motion or extra equipment. Static illustrative appearance only: no skating ability, blade sharpening, actual balance, fit, grip, speed, structural load, manufacture or safety claim.
